name: Inbox and missed calls
short: Every call, text and form in one list. Missed calls get a text back in seconds.
long: Press “Simulate a missed call” and watch it happen: the phone rings out, a countdown runs, the text goes from the business’s own number, and the customer replies. One tap sends the booking link, and the booking lands in the diary with its deposit.
proves: The customer gets a text before they ring the next name on Google.
features: Calls, texts, web forms and Google messages in one list, newest first
A missed call answered by text in seconds, with the exact message and timing
Send the booking link, book them in yourself, or write a quote from the thread
What the customer sees, shown on their phone beside yours
story: Every trade loses work to a phone that rang while they were under a floor. This is the part that catches it.
